static_traits.family_status: 独自生活，祖父母已去世
static_traits.social_status: 缺乏可倾诉的社会支持（without人可舒适地讨论感受）；Interpersonal relationshipsNot disclosed
static_traits.medical_history: 此前without类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，合作度高，能进行自我Reflection；自我评价严苛、负性情绪强度高（8–9/10）；态度积极、愿意尝试新策略

basic_info.main_problem: Whenever I miss an episode of my favorite anime, I feel I am the 'worst fan in history', falling into strong self-criticism and negative emotions; in recent weeks this has become stronger and affects the enjoyment of watching the program.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize self-criticism is affecting my enjoyment of the things I love, and I hope to receive counseling support to change these automatic negative thoughts.
growth_experiences: Grandparents have passed away, now living alone; lacking a support system with whom to discuss feelings.

core_beliefs: I am the worst fan in history

special_situations.event: Missing an episode of a favorite anime
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我错过一集，我就not是一个真正的粉丝
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过严苛的自我批评来约束自己not再错过
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am the worst fan in history

special_situations.event: 与其他粉丝比较，看到他们从not漏看并总是了解最新进展
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by being as perfect as others or even better does one count as a qualified fan
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断拿自己与他人比较来监控并评价自我价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们/我not是一个真正的粉丝

special_situations.event: After missing an episode, sets 'should/must' standards for self
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须时刻紧跟进度、绝not能漏看，否则就not合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: use“应该/必须”的自我要求来强迫自己维持标准
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更会跟进这些节目

special_situations.event: When noticing a plot point they had missed, focusing only on the negative and ignoring the facts that it can still be caught up on and that they still love it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦出现瑕疵，所有积极面都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极证据、维持负面自我标签来驱动自我改进

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为“真正/合格的粉丝”，Gaining recognition与自我价值感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被定义为not够好或“not是真正的粉丝”，因此被贬低或排斥
defense_goal: 通过严苛自我要求与自责来维持控制感与“合格标准”，以避免被视为not合格

object_relations.self_representation: not够格、容易失败的自己（一旦漏看就not合格）
object_relations.object_representation: 完美且not容差错的他人/粉丝群体（总能紧跟进度）

manifestations: 独自生活、祖父母去世；without合适对象可谈论感受与困扰
outcomes: Intensified self-criticism与负性情绪增强；享受事物的能力下降

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 对自己比对朋友更苛刻的标准
Frequent self-blame ('I am the worst fan')
Tightly binds self-worth to whether an episode was missed

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: use“应该/必须”的自我要求（“我应该更会跟进我的节目”）
将“漏看一集=not是真正粉丝”的规则直接当作绝对标准

positive_force: Positive attitude; willing to try new strategies and seek professional support
具备自我Reflection能力，可进行证据检视与重构（可辨识朋友也会漏看）
Passionate about beloved things; willing to improve the experience
negative_force: Comparing oneself with others leads to self-deprecation
大量“应该/必须”自我要求（Introjection）
Weak social support，缺乏可倾诉对象

target_behavior.behavior: Strong self-criticism and negative emotions when missing an episode
antecedent: Missing an episode of a favorite anime
与其他粉丝的完美追更进行比较
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized strict fan standards and all-or-nothing / overgeneralization cognitive patterns, equating one missed catch with complete failure
target_behavior.function: 通过自责来维持与Reinforcement“合格粉丝”的Introjection标准，试图逼迫自己not再漏看
target_behavior.consequence: 观看体验受损、情绪显著下降并Persistent self-criticism，进一步削弱对节目的享受
